reportWizard.title: OFG Progress Report — {{name}}
reportWizard.uploadIntro: This joins two credit report PDFs into one branded 3-page OFG progress report: enrollment (before) + current (after). We extract scores and negative items for your review before publishing.
reportWizard.beforeReportHint: Usually the Smart Credit PDF from when the client started.
reportWizard.afterReportHint: The latest credit report PDF to compare against enrollment.
reportWizard.highlightHint: Call out one removal on the wins table (e.g. a collection that dropped).
reportWizard.tradelineRecHint: Adds a coded tradeline tip on page 3 (IH-1 style — never real cardholder names).
reportWizard.tradelineRecLegend: Adds a short tradeline tip on page 3, coded as IH-1 (never real cardholder names — compliance). Example: “Projected +15–25 points when reporting updates.”
reportWizard.fundingNoteHint: Adds a short “on track for funding” note on page 3 (no guarantees).
reportWizard.fundingNoteLegend: Adds a soft funding line on page 3, e.g. “On track for improved funding readiness…” (no score or funding guarantees).
reportWizard.spanishLocaleHint: Labels, action plan, and CROA disclosure in Spanish.
reportWizard.spanishLocaleLegend: Switches report labels, action plan, and CROA disclosure to Spanish.
reportWizard.extracting: Extracting scores and tradelines from both PDFs…
reportWizard.reviewIntro: Review extracted data against the source PDFs. Low-confidence scores are flagged for manual verification.
reportWizard.complianceAttestation: I verified scores and removed items against the source credit reports. This report will include the required CROA disclosure.
reportWizard.scoreAnomalyHint: Large drops usually mean a mis-read score (wrong PDF or extraction). Fix the Before/After numbers above, then preview again. Preview is allowed so you can verify; publishing requires an extra acknowledgment.
reportWizard.scoreAnomalyAckTitle: I confirm these score drops are accurate
reportWizard.scoreAnomalyAckBody: I double-checked the source PDFs and accept publishing with the large bureau score drop(s) shown in review.
reportWizard.previewIntro: Review the generated 3-page OFG report before publishing to the client portal.
reportWizard.publishedBody: Round {{round}} report is live in the client portal. Pipeline stage updated and client notified.

adminPipeline.splitPaidLegendBody: The client will not be notified — no email, SMS, or payment link is generated for rows marked Paid.
adminPipeline.modeManualHint: Tracked on the schedule only. Admin marks it paid later — no client payment link or reminder.
adminPipeline.modeLinkHint: Creates a /pay link the client can use. Reminders can include this link when a reminder flow is attached.
adminPipeline.modePaidHint: Recorded as paid now (manual). The client will not be notified and no payment link is created.
adminPipeline.newCaseNoEmail: Creating a case here does not email the client. Use Convert Prospect (or Bulk Import with welcome emails) if they need a portal invite.
adminPipeline.newCasePackageNote: Free-text note only — does not link a real package product. To attach a package, use Convert Prospect or edit the case later.
adminPipeline.newCaseStageWarn: Starting past New Client skips normal onboarding expectations (tasks, docs verified). Only do this if the client is already mid-pipeline.
adminPipeline.splitIncomplete: Installment rows need both amount and due date or they will be ignored when you create the case.

adminHelpers.clientStatusNote: Account status controls portal access and billing state. It is separate from the pipeline stage on the Kanban board.

clientStatus.pending_payment: Checkout started but payment not completed.
clientStatus.onboarding: Paid / converted — completing Get Started tasks.
clientStatus.active: Normal working client with portal access.
clientStatus.paused: Temporarily held — do not advance work until resumed.
clientStatus.cancelled: Account closed. Prefer pipeline Cancelled for case workflow.
clientStatus.prospect: Lead only — no case yet. Convert before treating as a client.

adminHelpers.emailChangeHint: Changing email updates login identity. Existing magic links to the old address will stop working.
adminHelpers.createClientNoEmail: Create client does not send a welcome email. Use Bulk Import or Convert Prospect when you need a portal invite.

teamStatus.active: Can sign in and use the admin panel.

teamStatus.suspended: Blocked immediately — use for security or policy holds.

adminHelpers.autoAssignHint: When on, this task is auto-created for new clients after payment / case creation.
adminHelpers.mimeHint: Examples: image/*,application/pdf — comma-separated MIME types or wildcards. Typos break client uploads.
adminHelpers.signHtmlHint: HTML is shown to the client as-is. Preview in a test client before going live.
adminHelpers.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers appear first. Ties use creation order.
adminHelpers.couponTimezone: Times are in your browser’s local timezone.
adminHelpers.couponCodeHint: Letters, numbers, - and _. Saved in UPPERCASE.
adminHelpers.couponMinOrder: Checkout subtotal must be at least this amount (USD) before the coupon can apply.
adminHelpers.splitCancelNoNotify: The client is not emailed when you cancel. Their payment link (if any) stops working.
adminHelpers.splitDeleteNoNotify: Permanently removes the installment. The client is not notified.
adminHelpers.publishReportHint: Publishing makes the report visible in the client portal. It does not automatically email the client.
adminHelpers.settingsNoDescription: No description on file — confirm the expected value format before saving. Wrong values can affect live behavior.
adminHelpers.settingsSaveWarn: Saved settings apply immediately to the live app.
adminHelpers.markdownHint: Supports basic Markdown (headings, links, lists). Use Preview to verify before relying on it live.
